description: This file implements the 'git prune' command, handling object pruning based on reachability and expiration time. It contains core logic for removing stale temporary files, unreachable objects, and handling repository object cleanup.

methods.name: int prune_tmp_file(const char * fullpath)
methods.description: Removes a temporary file or directory if its modification time is older than the expiration time. Handles both files and directories, printing removal messages when applicable.

methods.name: void perform_reachability_traversal(struct rev_info * revs)
methods.description: Performs a reachability traversal of objects in the repository, initializing progress display if enabled, and marking reachable objects.

methods.name: int is_object_reachable(const struct object_id * oid,struct rev_info * revs)
methods.description: Checks whether a specific object identified by its OID is reachable within the repository, performing reachability traversal if necessary.

methods.name: int prune_object(const struct object_id * oid,const char * fullpath,void * data)
methods.description: Prunes a given object file if it is unreachable and older than the expiration time. Reports its action when verbose or dry-run mode is enabled.

methods.name: int prune_cruft(const char * basename,const char * path,void * data UNUSED)
methods.description: Handles removal of temporary or crufty files starting with 'tmp_obj_' and reports bad SHA1 files.

methods.name: int prune_subdir(unsigned int nr UNUSED,const char * path,void * data UNUSED)
methods.description: Removes subdirectories in the object directory if not in dry-run mode.

methods.name: void remove_temporary_files(const char * path)
methods.description: Recursively scans a directory for temporary files starting with 'tmp_' and attempts to remove them.

methods.name: int cmd_prune(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo)
methods.description: Main command handler for 'git prune'. Parses options, initializes revisions, processes specified objects, and performs pruning operations including cleaning up loose objects, packed objects, and shallow objects.

ctags.name: cmd_prune
ctags.signature: (int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo)

ctags.name: prune_cruft
ctags.signature: (const char * basename,const char * path,void * data UNUSED)

ctags.name: prune_object
ctags.pattern: /^static int prune_object(const struct object_id *oid, const char *fullpath,$/
ctags.signature: (const struct object_id * oid,const char * fullpath,void * data)

ctags.name: prune_subdir
ctags.pattern: /^static int prune_subdir(unsigned int nr UNUSED, const char *path,$/
ctags.signature: (unsigned int nr UNUSED,const char * path,void * data UNUSED)
